ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Disability Social Justice: This dialogue course introduces students to perspectives in disability social justice. We will explore the histories, socio-legal contexts, ideas, and special topics that have shaped movements toward disability social justice. Meets 17-Oct-22- 7-Dec-22. 1 Hour (letter-graded) credit, second-half session class. Offered in collaboration with Diversity & Social Justice Education (DSJE). Go to website http://go.illinois.edu/EPSY203 for more detailed descriptions of the classes. If you still have questions AFTER VIEWING THE WEBSITE, you can email diversityEd@illinois.edu.
